headline: European and Asian Equities Volatile Amid AI Sector Losses and Oil Pressures
summary: European and Asian stock markets experienced volatility and declines following a sell-off in U.S. technology shares tied to concerns over the artificial intelligence trade and elevated energy costs.
why: Equity indices aggregate regional valuations, and sharp corrections in heavyweight technology or energy sectors impact broader investor sentiment and institutional portfolios.

impacts.name: Technology
impacts.why: Re-evaluations of sector valuations and growth expectations led to profit-taking in high-flying technology equities.

why_moved: Spillovers from domestic technology sell-offs and macroeconomic uncertainty reduced risk appetite across international exchanges.
